infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Salareen uses the microphone for live class audio and Drive Mode voice questions.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Salareen uses your camera for live class video when you turn your webcam on.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Salareen uses speech recognition so you can ask questions hands-free in Drive Mode.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Detect when you are driving so Salareen can offer hands-free Drive Mode.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Use device motion to improve driving detection while Drive Mode is enabled.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach screenshots when you report a bug, or pick a profile image in class activities.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Salareen only saves to your photo library if you choose to export or save learning materials.
